purpose: Teach and evaluate the connected understanding-imagination-investigation-credit loop across human language, mathematics, coding, sciences and interpretation.

stages.gate: Input-to-situation grounding and learned candidate construction connected; human held-out wording retained.
Multiple observed systems; independent integrator/outcome; actuator checks; no hidden mechanism labels.
Exact checker or scoped proof assessment; human worked problems; multiple routes with conditions.
Bounded interpreter/sandbox and independent hidden tests; source references are teaching, not learner output.
Qualified human source and assessed tasks for each subject; confidence separate from model adequacy.
Human source support and independent rubric; multiple defensible interpretations; no self-grading credit.
Learned goal/proposal/evidence choice, return to original task, qualified novelty and durable reward updates.

training_schedule.plateau_action: Preserve candidate and exposure, diagnose on development only, repair a genuine defect or move to the next subject. Do not pad updates or farm rewards.
training_schedule.phase_order_changes: Record a prospective amendment with evidence before continuing; no final-based tuning.
training_schedule.early_stopping: A measured gate/plateau can shorten a stage; totals are maximum finite allocations, not required padding.

evaluation.control_budget: Freeze matched source/exposure/update and assessment budgets for each mechanistic comparison; do not compare a 262144-update learner with an untrained control as proof of mechanism.
evaluation.human_interpretation_gate: Keep interpretation credit pending without independent qualified assessment; corpus retrieval is evidence, not a semantic grading oracle.

resource_policy.occupied_lease_action: Wait or do read-only preparation; never take or stop another owner's job.
resource_policy.runtime_estimate: Measure one sustained development segment before forecasting total runtime; no unsupported duration promise.

release_gate: Independent replay, protected-reference hashes, complete source/exposure/cost/negative ledger, and row-by-row paper/behavior audit; no automatic production promotion.
